title: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
描述评分指标或评测协议
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with human execution, the executors matched the human consensus for 66.1% to 88.1% of the sampled fixes.
